user.title: Set up Eqiva smart lock
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant should authenticate with the lock.

key_card.title: Pair using Key Card
key_card.description: Scan the QR code from the Eqiva Key Card. Then hold the unlock button on the lock until the yellow LED flashes and submit this form. Key Card data is not stored after pairing.

credentials.title: Existing KeyBLE credentials
credentials.description: Use an already registered user ID and its 128-bit user key.

error.not_found: The lock has not yet been seen by Home Assistant Bluetooth.
error.invalid_key_card: The Key Card data is invalid.
error.pairing_failed: Pairing failed. Check Bluetooth range and enable pairing mode on the lock.
error.invalid_credentials: The Bluetooth address, user ID, or user key is invalid.
error.cannot_connect: Connection or authentication with the lock failed.
